newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boatmen's cut to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boatmen's cut to sell.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Friday it downgraded Boatmen's Bancshares Inc to sell from underweight after NationsBank Corp said it agreed to acquire Boatmen's in a stock deal. Boatmen's stock was up 10-15/16 to 53-7/8 after the news.

- Analyst Ross Demmerle said in a report, "Prior to the announcement our underweight rating reflected Boatmen's poor fundamentals. We now move it to sell, recommending to take any profits you may have based on Boatmen's move to 55-1/4 at the opening this morning."
He said the deal is expected to close in January "but there is always the risk the deal (may fall) through."
